messages:
Samira Khan: Heads-up: cloud announced deprecation of eu-central-1 GPUs for our Dedicated fleet in Q4. need a safe multi-tenant evacuation plan that respects EU-only contractual residency. can we sketch a practical operator flow?
Diego Ruiz: We should avoid a big-bang. proposal: staged relocations by customer cohort (priority: low-risk -> high-risk). low-risk = customers with backups + no custom legal clause. high-risk = EU_ONLY customers (contracts).
Priya Gupta: Confirmed from contracts: ~12 customers are strict EU_ONLY. they require either (1) move to another EU region or (2) export + deletion proof. No cross-border fallback allowed.
InfraBot: automation idea: create an infra-state machine per-tenant: PENDING -> SNAPSHOTTING -> TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS -> VALIDATING -> CUTOVER -> COMPLETED. provide a CLI for operators and REST hooks for portal. sample CLI:
```
ri-ops tenant migrate --tenant 9876 --to eu-west-1 --start
```
Samira Khan: Nice. Important: must preserve billing/telemetry continuity. suggest overlapping read window: reads serviced by both old and new region for 2 hours after cutover; writes to target only. That lets us compare token counts and latencies.
Diego Ruiz: Agree. Also need to consider cached KV and live sessions. plan: drain active sessions on old region, prime cache on new region with recent access patterns. add a cache-replay job that replays the last 24h of prefixes.
Priya Gupta: Legal asks for an auditable export artifact: SHA256 manifest of exported objects, time-stamped attestation, and a deletion ticket ID. we must keep audit logs 90 days after transfer completion.
InfraBot: Proposed metrics to add: residency.evacuate.duration, residency.evacuate.errors, residency.evacuate.rows_mismatch. Tag metrics by tenant_id and target_region. Alert if rows_mismatch > 0 or duration > SLA threshold.
Samira Khan: Router protections: if tenant.residency == EU_ONLY then any fallback route to non-EU must be explicitly denied at proxy level. also ensure circuit-breaker messages return 451 instead of 500 so customers get clear guidance.
Diego Ruiz: Operational play: create a canary cohort (3 tenants) with low traffic but representative workloads (generation + embeddings). run full transfer, validate parity, and ramp to 10% then full. document rollback criteria: checksum mismatch, sustained latency regression (>30% P95), or billing delta > 10%.
Priya Gupta: Customer comms: portal banner + portal action for "Request managed export". include expected timelines and deletion attestation template. require opt-in for cross-region move if customers are EU_ONLY.
Samira Khan: Who owns runbook and the controls? I can author the runbook outline. Diego, can you implement cache priming + replay? Priya, you'll handle customer messaging + legal attestation template.
Diego Ruiz: I'll add proxy guard code and a unit test. snippet for proxy decision logic:
```
if headers['X-Tenant-Residency']=='EU_ONLY' and candidate_region not in EU_REGIONS:
  return 451, "Region not allowed for tenant residency"
```
InfraBot: Scheduling note: recommend maintenance windows outside EU business hours and provide a test slack channel when first canary starts (#eu-evac-canary).
Priya Gupta: Also add a retention-lock step: after transfer we mark tenant as PENDING_DELETION until legal signs off, then final wipe. record attestation in ticket.
Samira Khan: TL;DR checklist for runbook PR:
- tenant residency discovery + opt-out list
- preflight capacity and quota checks in target EU region
- canary cohort selection + phased ramping plan
- snapshot -> transfer -> validation (checksums + row counts)
- KV cache priming + session drain + replay job
- telemetry metrics (residency.evacuate.*) + overlap-read window to preserve billing continuity
- proxy guard to prevent cross-border fallbacks (451 responses)
- audit/export artifact + deletion attestation + 90-day logs retention
- rollback criteria and operator gates
- customer portal actions and support playbook

Samira Khan: I'll open the runbook PR and schedule the cross-functional kickoff this week. create #eu-evac-canary when we start.
Diego Ruiz: :thumbsup:
Priya Gupta: On it — will draft legal attestation and portal text.
InfraBot: reminder: create incident channel when the first canary begins. suggested name: #sunset-eu-gpu-drain.
